strings.zh: 从上面掉下来,{NEWLINE}也就是说……{SCROLL}你完成了石版的拼图？！{SCROLL}太棒了！{SCROLL}看来你很有考古才能啊！{CLEAR}我把这个笔记给你吧,{SCROLL}抓到的未知图腾会自动记录起来,{CLEAR}非常方便！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Did you just come down from above...?{SCROLL}So! You must have solved the{NEWLINE}stone-panel puzzle!{SCROLL}That is wonderful!{SCROLL}You seem to have some talent with{NEWLINE}archaeology.{CLEAR}I will give you this Unown Report.{SCROLL}It records Unown as you capture them.{NEWLINE}I am sure it’ll come in handy!{SCROLL}
There is a strange presence here...

strings.zh: 虽然遗迹下面的石室很大,{NEWLINE}但我在这里除了古代雕像,{CLEAR}没见到什么口袋妖怪。{SCROLL}不过也有人说他们在这里{NEWLINE}遇到了未知图腾。{CLEAR}可我从来都没见过,{CLEAR}真是有够奇怪的。
strings.en: The stone chambers under the{NEWLINE}ruins are huge, but apart from{CLEAR}the ancient statues, I haven’t{CLEAR}seen any Pokémon down here.{SCROLL}Still, some people say they’ve{NEWLINE}run into Unown here. I’ve never{CLEAR}seen one myself. Weird, huh?

strings.zh: 阿鲁夫遗迹给人的感觉……{NEWLINE}该说是神圣的吗　,{CLEAR}还是说有历史感的呢？{CLEAR}其中又夹杂着一点不详。{SCROLL}这种神秘的感觉非常那以表达,{NEWLINE}真好奇当时的人们{CLEAR}是为了什么而建造的遗迹。
strings.en: The Ruins of Alph feel... sacred,{NEWLINE}I guess? Or should I say historic?{CLEAR}And mixed in with that, there’s{CLEAR}something a little ominous.{SCROLL}It’s such a mysterious feeling, it’s{NEWLINE}hard to put into words. I wonder why{CLEAR}the people back then built these ruins.

strings.zh: 这座遗迹既未被盗贼光顾过,{CLEAR}也没有被人{CLEAR}乱涂乱画过,{SCROLL}几乎是以和从前一样的{NEWLINE}状态保存下来了。{SCROLL}这里一定有什么东西,{NEWLINE}才能做到这种程度。
strings.en: These ruins have never been visited by{NEWLINE}thieves or scribbled on. They’ve been{CLEAR}preserved almost exactly as they were{CLEAR}long ago. Something here must be what{CLEAR}keeps them like this.
strings.notes: US 0076/4 | RV031: meaning: US added ‘make people feel they should preserve it’

strings.zh: 依照从前的精灵的样子{NEWLINE}建造的东西。
strings.en: It’s a replica of an ancient Pokémon.

strings.zh: 我从阿鲁夫研究所买了一本{NEWLINE}研究未知图腾的笔记本,{CLEAR}想着好好研究一下未知图腾的秘密。{SCROLL}可惜研究的过程太困难太枯燥,{NEWLINE}不得已只能放弃了。{CLEAR}好在有一个看起来很有精神的少年{CLEAR}对未知图腾似乎很有兴趣,{CLEAR}我就把笔记本送给他了。
strings.en: I bought a notebook for studying{NEWLINE}Unown from the Research Center,{CLEAR}hoping to really dig into their secrets.{SCROLL}But the research was way too hard{NEWLINE}and way too dull, so I had to give up.{SCROLL}Luckily, there was an energetic-looking{NEWLINE}boy who seemed really into Unown,{CLEAR}so I gave the notebook to him.

strings.zh: 我要研究一下未知图腾的秘密,{NEWLINE}争取成为口袋妖怪考古界的专家！
strings.en: I’m going to study the secrets{NEWLINE}of the Unown and become an{CLEAR}expert in Pokémon archaeology!

strings.zh: 雕像上渐渐映出了{VAR:0103:0}的脸！{SCROLL}要摸摸看吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}’s face slowly{NEWLINE}appeared on the statue!{SCROLL}Touch it?
